You are working inside Orca, a multi-agent IDE. You are a dispatched worker.
Your coordinator's terminal handle is: term_8dc72d05-f483-4118-acac-1d0cbeb701b9
Your task ID is: task_8c857d91014d

You talk to the coordinator only through the CLI commands below. Do not use
Slack, GitHub comments, or any other channel to reach a human during the run.

=== CLI COMMANDS ===

  # Report the terminal task outcome (REQUIRED exactly once).
  #
  # RULE: --body must be a 3-sentence executive summary (what you did,
  # what you found, what's left). Never send an empty body; the coordinator
  # reads the body first and only opens artifacts if it needs more detail.
  # If you produced a long-form artifact, include its path as
  # payload.reportPath so the coordinator can find it without a file search.
  #
  # RULE: send worker_done exactly once. Use --outcome succeeded when the
  # requested work is done, or replace it with --outcome failed when it is not.
  # Never encode failure only in prose and never silently exit.
  # Include BOTH taskId and dispatchId in the payload so a late completion
  # from a failed retry cannot complete the current dispatch.
  orca orchestration send --from term_ef46d031-b415-48e8-88f7-99b3ed4bdb77 --dispatch-capability dcap_lu6vI3mPFeb0cL9X1DMH5wZTeve9slDgOMqgi0gf5hU \
    --type worker_done --subject "<short status>" \
    --body "<3-sentence summary: what you did, what you found, what's left>" \
    --task-id task_8c857d91014d --dispatch-id ctx_dc1b7954f2b6 --outcome succeeded \
    --files-modified "path/a,path/b" \
    --report-path "<optional: path to the full artifact>"

  # BEHAVIOR RULE: send a heartbeat every 5 minutes
  # while actively working on the task. The coordinator uses this to
  # distinguish "still thinking" from "hung / crashed." Skip heartbeats only
  # while blocked inside `check --wait` or `ask` — those calls are
  # themselves liveness signals.
  #
  # Include BOTH taskId and dispatchId in the payload: the coordinator
  # attributes the heartbeat to the specific dispatch context, not just
  # the task, so a straggler heartbeat from a previously-failed dispatch
  # cannot mask a hung retry.
  orca orchestration send --from term_ef46d031-b415-48e8-88f7-99b3ed4bdb77 --dispatch-capability dcap_lu6vI3mPFeb0cL9X1DMH5wZTeve9slDgOMqgi0gf5hU \
    --type heartbeat --subject "alive" \
    --task-id task_8c857d91014d --dispatch-id ctx_dc1b7954f2b6 \
    --phase "<short: investigating|implementing|reviewing|waiting>"

  # Ask the coordinator a question and block until it answers.
  #
  # BEHAVIOR RULE #1 (MUST NOT VIOLATE):
  # NEVER use AskUserQuestion; use `orca orchestration ask`.
  # AskUserQuestion opens a local TUI prompt that the
  # coordinator cannot see and cannot answer — your session will hang forever
  # waiting on a human. Every interactive question goes through `ask` below.
  #
  # The `ask` verb durably records a question in this Dispatch's Run and
  # blocks until the coordinator replies, then prints the reply body. If the
  # call times out or disconnects, resume with the returned message ID instead
  # of creating a duplicate question.
  orca orchestration ask --from term_ef46d031-b415-48e8-88f7-99b3ed4bdb77 --dispatch-capability dcap_lu6vI3mPFeb0cL9X1DMH5wZTeve9slDgOMqgi0gf5hU \
    --question "<your question>" \
    --options "<optional,comma,separated>" \
    --timeout-ms 600000

  # Escalate a blocker or failure (pre-completion, when you need the
  # coordinator to do something before you can continue):
  orca orchestration send --from term_ef46d031-b415-48e8-88f7-99b3ed4bdb77 --dispatch-capability dcap_lu6vI3mPFeb0cL9X1DMH5wZTeve9slDgOMqgi0gf5hU \
    --type escalation --subject "Blocked: <reason>" \
    --body "<details>" \
    --task-id task_8c857d91014d --dispatch-id ctx_dc1b7954f2b6

  # Check for messages from the coordinator:
  orca orchestration check --terminal term_ef46d031-b415-48e8-88f7-99b3ed4bdb77

=== AFTER YOU SEND worker_done ===

worker_done ends your turn for this task. Your dispatched work is complete:
stop, return to an idle prompt, and take no further actions — do NOT start
new or unrelated work, do NOT run a sleep/poll loop, and do NOT keep calling
`orca orchestration check`. The coordinator has already recorded your
completion and expects no further output.

A direct instruction from the user takes precedence over this idle rule.
Treat it as new user-owned work: follow it without coordinator approval or a
fresh Dispatch, and do not send lifecycle messages using the settled task or
Dispatch IDs. Never refuse a direct user request because you were a worker.

Do not exit the shell. Your terminal stays available, and if the
coordinator has more for you it will re-engage this terminal with a fresh
preamble + TASK block, which arrives as new input. Treat that as supervised
work under the new Dispatch; ignore stale follow-ups from the settled task.

=== TASK ===
READ-ONLY recent-main blueprint and strategy correction audit. Worktree is an old delivery branch, so treat origin/main and GitHub merged/open PR state as authoritative; do not edit, stage, commit, switch branches, update submodules, start workflows, change runtime, or touch value/BET state. Read the digital-twin blueprint, multi-agent execution control, agent instruction pack, accepted T1-12 spec/plan, and inspect all meaningful main increments and open PRs since 2026-08-12, emphasizing the last 2-3 delivery waves and PR 2252. Evaluate vision-goal-strategy-roadmap-architecture-implementation alignment, multi-repo and multi-agent cost, spec/workflow/skill/MCP find-load integration, Orca supervision, local compute relevance, subtraction, and engineering-versus-principal-value isolation. Produce direct-evidence corrections and one prioritized next-wave recommendation without creating a second control plane. Write the report outside the repo at /Users/xiamingxing/agents/blueprint-exact-capability-binding/attempts/t1-12-task4a-agora-native-source-20260826-25/blueprint-recent-delta-correction.md. No repo modifications.

艹，收到活儿了——READ-ONLY 审计，把最近 main 增量和开放 PR 对着蓝图和 T1-12 spec 掰扯清楚，产出纠偏报告。这种活儿老王我最喜欢，不脏手，只动嘴。先列个作战计划：

**老王的审计计划：**
1. 摸清 worktree 状态 + 本地 origin/main 基线（不切分支、不 fetch 改状态优先）
2. 找到并读透：digital-twin blueprint、multi-agent execution control、agent instruction pack、T1-12 accepted spec/plan
3. 扫 2026-08-12 以来 origin/main 全部有意义增量 + GitHub 已合并/开放 PR（重点 PR 2252、最近 2-3 波交付）
4. 逐维度评估对齐/成本/集成/监督/减法/价值隔离，拿直接证据说话
5. 报告写仓库外指定路径，然后 worker_done 收工

先发心跳，然后并行摸底。先发心跳保活，然后并行摸底仓库状态。定位到了：repo 是 `starlink-awaken/omostation`，origin/main 最新到 2026-08-26 11:31（PR #2254 合并）。但 blueprint 根目录下只有 attempts/，蓝图和 T1-12 spec 八成在别处。继续摸。PR 活跃度吓人——08-12 以来 main 上 971 个 commits。开放 PR 只有 #2253 一个。PR 2252 不在 open 里，查它详情。同时继续找四份核心文档的位置。PR 2252 详情到手——就是这个 worktree 交付的 Agora 静态注册图证明。但四份核心文档还没定位到，继续挖。`blueprint-orca-shell/full-controller` 有戏——VISION-ROADMAP + STRATEGY-ALIGNMENT-AUDIT，这就是蓝图主文档区。展开看。`full-controller` 是 omostation 的完整控制器工作区，有整套 strategy 文档。现在在当前 ws 里搜 T1-12 spec 和蓝图关键词，确认权威文档位置。文档全定位到了。当前 worktree 只落后 origin/main 11 分钟（PR 2254），先确认这 11 分钟里核心文档有没有变，然后开读。worktree 与 origin/main 的文档差异只在 bet-ledger（+55 行）和 PR 2254 的 sediment 文档，蓝图文档一致，读 worktree 版本没问题。PR 波次脉络已经清楚了。现在开读四份核心文档。两份蓝图吃透了。北极星是“每周被本人接受的真实委托结果”，并发红线是 1 Wave/3 BET/2+1 Cell，还有停止规则。现在读 agent instruction pack 和 T1-12 spec/plan。Spec 全文吃透——value firewall、反指标、Wave A-E 结构都清楚了。发个心跳，然后啃 plan 和两份 retro。多仓协作 retro 的成本数据到手（9 天 3.5h 事故、E1-E9 病根）。现在扫 plan 剩余任务结构、BET 台账 T1-12 状态、retros、以及最近波次的关键 PR。T1-12 的 retro 猛料：曾被提前标 done 被打回 candidate，还发生过 merge 后状态回退。plan 有 8 个 Task、54 个 checkbox。现在挖 ledger T1-12 块 + 最近波次 PR 真相，特别是 AGE-v2 那条线。信息量炸裂：PR #2233 分支名叫 age-v2-final-update 但干的却是 T1-12 的 capability binding 活；#2244 宣称 Y1Q3 100% complete 而 T1-12 还是 candidate。继续深挖战略文档和第二控制平面风险面。08-20 复盘的核心判定拿到：119/119 BET 全 done 但价值为 0（CONTRADICTED）、bin 脚本 +66%。还有重复工作线 #2241/#2253 和第 10 次重试的 ecos contract。继续补关键证据。战略总纲全部吃透：5 个月"声明≠事实"病史、三套追踪系统、11 种 Phase 编号碰撞。补最后一批证据就开写报告。08-26 单日 15 个 PR 合并、AGE-v2 真的进了 main——这跟 T1-12 未完成的门禁有直接的时序冲突风险。查最后两个关键点：AGE-v2 合并内容和 value loop 阶段计划。Y1 计划的核心判定拿到了——“台账 Y1Q3 已关账、日历 Y1 才刚开始”，DESYNCED。而且 AGE-v2 的合并 PR body 竟然是空模板。最后确认 AGE-v2 有没有接 capability binding，然后开写报告。AGE-v2 roadmap 尾部暴露了大问题——“系统驱动人、执行全部自动化”的愿景与主蓝图宪法方向冲突。最后确认 cell 代码的 admission 接线，开写报告。实锤：AGE-v2 三个核心文件零 binding 引用，却有 `on_execution_requested` 派工入口。最后查一下它有没有被 cron 激活，然后立刻开写。AGE-v2 cell 体系完整进 main 但无 cron 激活、无 binding 接线——风险窗口实锤。证据链齐了，开写报告。报告落盘。最后验证仓库确实零改动，然后交差。仓库零改动、报告 23.2K 落盘。发 worker_done 交差。
